name: What are the benefits of using design-build services for a custom home compared to traditional separate architect and builder contracts?
description: Design-build services offer integrated design and construction under one contract, leading to better communication, cost control, and a streamlined project time

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of using design-build services for a custom home compared to traditional separate architect and builder contracts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Design-build services integrate architectural design and construction under one contract, offering a single point of responsibility. This approach often leads to better communication, cost control, and a more streamlined project timeline compared to traditional separate contracts. With design-build, potential construction challenges can be identified and addressed during the design phase, reducing unexpected issues later on. This integrated process fosters a collaborative environment, ensuring the project stays aligned with your vision and budget from conception to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Design-build services offer integrated design and construction under one contract, leading to better communication, cost control, and a streamlined project timeline. This approach minimizes unexpected issues.
